text:
tim: PTAL at PR #4231 — batching hotpath tweak + small smoke added. need one quick LGTM to get this into release today. link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/4231
sarah: on it, starting a quick pass
kevin: quick q — you renamed batch_size_hist -> batch_size_bucket, is that going to break dashboards/backfills?
tim: it's additive for now, original metric still emitted for two releases. added a migration note in the PR description
mina: ran a local smoke: `pytest tests/runtime/test_batcher.py::test_hotpath -q -k smoke` passed 9/10. flaky when seq_len=8, saw a prefetch miss spike in logs
tim: thanks Mina — i'll try bumping prefetch ttl, left an inline comment
dave: i can finish the review in ~15m
ops-bot: CI / smoke-tests passed (run id: 8342) :white_check_mark:
sarah: left a tiny nit about docstring formatting, otherwise looks good :+1:
kevin: approve with a comment to add the metric rename to the ops playbook
min a: typo fix pushed — re-ran with TTL=20ms (see config below), smoke 10/10
tim: config I used for the local smoke:
```
batcher.prefetch_ttl_ms: 20
batcher.max_batch_tokens: 8192
```
mina: approve
tim: awesome, merging in ~5m. will watch canary metrics after rollout
ops-bot: merged runtime/pr-4231 into release/v2.4 (user tim) :robot_face:
tim: kicking canary to 5% now — dashboard: https://internal.redwood/observability/dashboards/batcher-hotpath
mina: watching p50/p95/p99, will alert if p99 > 120ms
kevin: noted. i'll file a follow-up to add metric deprecation steps to docs
sarah: nice, thanks everyone :tada:
